clue.text: Greek city where frescoes, say, seen in bath

indicators.note: something seen in a place sits within it, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a spa is a bath or resort with medicinal waters
frescoes are an example of art, hence 'say'

explanation.surface: A Greek city where wall paintings are on view at the baths.
explanation.definitionFit: Sparta was the ancient Greek city-state famed for its warriors.

clue.text: Yours truly aims with HB to write about Indian madam

parts.note: a setter's way of saying 'me'

indicators.note: about signals the letters are moved around into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written: the pencil grade

explanation.surface: The setter takes an HB pencil to write about an Indian lady.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' makes MSAHIB of AIMS and HB; 'to write' is a link alluding to the HB pencil.
explanation.definitionFit: Memsahib was the respectful term used in colonial India for a married European woman.

clue.text: Moving as it happens around old lake, first of tourists

indicators.note: around tells us one piece wraps the others

parts.note: a broadcast that is live goes out as it happens
Lake Como is a lake in northern Italy

indicators.note: first of picks the opening letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A tour party moving round an old lake, reported live.
explanation.definitionFit: Locomotive as an adjective describes the power of moving from place to place.

clue.text: Wine was promoted

definitions.meaning: past tense of rise, as in climbing the ranks

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a pink wine and the past tense of a verb for going up in rank.

clue.text: New loan great, more adaptable, building finally secured

indicators.note: secured means held inside, so one piece goes within the other
something adaptable can be reshaped, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

indicators.note: finally picks the closing letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A homeowner secures a great new loan for building work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'adaptable' rearranges the two printed words into a nine-letter run; 'secured' holds the end letter of 'building' inside it, so this is a container round an anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Taking out a fresh mortgage on a property you already own is a new loan secured on it.

clue.text: Supporter, for example, describing Tottenham's header

indicators.note: to describe a shape is to draw round it, so one piece goes around the other

parts.note: say is used to introduce an example

indicators.note: header picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A football supporter describes a Tottenham player's header.
explanation.walkthrough: Tottenham is a London football club; a header is the ball struck with the head, but here it is a first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: A stay is a prop or support, such as a rope steadying a mast or a strut in a corset.

clue.text: List contains Asian capital that is coming up — this one?

indicators.note: contains means one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: to list or tip is to lean over to one side

indicators.note: a capital here is the first letter of the word
in a down clue, coming up reads the letters bottom to top

parts.note: i.e. is the abbreviation of id est, that is

explanation.surface: A list includes an Asian capital that is coming up: is it this one?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Asian capital' looks like the definition, but 'capital' only takes A from 'Asian'; the definition is the question at the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Taipei is the capital city of Taiwan, so it is an Asian capital that would answer the clue's question.

clue.text: Outsider finds park official getting underway?

indicators.note: getting joins the pieces, with the official placed below the way in this down light

parts.note: read as under way: way gives ST, the abbreviation of street, and the other piece sits under it
a park ranger looks after a national park

explanation.surface: An outsider finds a park warden setting off on a walk.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark asks you to split 'underway' into 'under way': way is a street, and in a down entry the official sits beneath it.
explanation.definitionFit: A stranger is someone unknown, from outside one's own circle or place.

clue.text: Chemical affecting behaviour, one behind champion in leader

indicators.note: behind puts this piece after the rest
in places one piece inside the other

parts.note: PM, the Prime Minister, is the national leader
a hero is a champion
taken as written

explanation.surface: A chemical influencing behaviour, put out by someone trailing a champion inside a leader.
explanation.definitionFit: A pheromone is a chemical released by an animal that changes the behaviour of others of its species.

clue.text: One's proposed to a good man

parts.note: taken as written
ST, saint, is a crossword's good man

explanation.surface: Someone is proposed to a good man, as at a wedding.
explanation.definitionFit: A toast is proposed at a celebration, raising glasses to someone.

clue.text: Teacher tossed over fish dish that's fried

indicators.note: tossed over means flipped round, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: pupils address a male teacher as sir
the sole is a flatfish

explanation.surface: A teacher flips a fish over in the frying pan.
explanation.walkthrough: 'fish dish' wants to be the definition, but 'fish' gives SOLE.
explanation.definitionFit: A rissole is a fried cake of minced meat or fish coated in breadcrumbs.

clue.text: Terrible myopia, claiming Louisiana's capital — is that of Washington?

indicators.note: claiming means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other
terrible suggests the letters are in a bad state and must be rearranged
capital here picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: Someone with awful short sight wonders whether Louisiana's capital is Washington's too.
explanation.walkthrough: The anagram of MYOPIA takes in L. 'that' stands for 'capital', so the definition reads as the capital of Washington state.
explanation.definitionFit: Olympia is the state capital of Washington in the US Pacific Northwest.

clue.text: Hardwood equally hard

parts.note: as, as in 'as good', means equally
H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A hardwood that is equally hard.
explanation.definitionFit: Ash is a tree whose tough timber is classed as a hardwood.

clue.text: As money still owed, it's wonderful

definitions.meaning: a debt not yet paid is said to be unpaid and pending

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both unpaid, of a debt, and exceptionally good.

clue.text: Claiming sixth sense, criminal arrests intruder

indicators.note: claiming means taking in, so one piece goes inside the other
criminal suggests the letters are bent out of shape and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
ESP, extrasensory perception, is the sixth sense

explanation.surface: A criminal claiming psychic powers arrests a burglar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'criminal' rearranges the printed word into TRASSER, and 'Claiming' takes the sixth sense inside that new order.
explanation.definitionFit: A trespasser goes onto land without permission, an unwanted intruder.

clue.text: Journalist trashing ten weirdos

indicators.note: trashing means wrecking, so the letters are broken up and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A journalist rubbishes ten oddballs in print.
explanation.definitionFit: A news editor is the journalist who runs a paper's news desk.

clue.text: I should accompany a friend travelling west in sheikhdom

indicators.note: in an across clue, going west means reading right to left

parts.note: bud is an American word for a pal

explanation.surface: I should go along with a friend heading west to a Gulf state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'travelling west' turns the whole string I, A, BUD to read right to left.
explanation.definitionFit: Dubai is one of the emirates ruled by a sheikh in the United Arab Emirates.

clue.text: Dionysius' courtier left company set up among ladies

indicators.note: among puts one piece inside the other

parts.note: dames are ladies

indicators.note: in a down clue, set up turns the letters bottom to top

explanation.surface: A courtier leaves a company set up among women.
explanation.walkthrough: 'set up' turns L and CO into OCL, which goes among DAMES.
explanation.definitionFit: Damocles was the courtier of Dionysius of Syracuse who sat beneath a sword hung by a single hair.

clue.text: Greek character took in returns

indicators.note: returns means comes back, so the word is read backwards

parts.note: ate means took in, as food

explanation.surface: A Greek character takes in his earnings.
explanation.definitionFit: Eta is the seventh letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Heron, say, fighting to catch dace, gutted

indicators.note: to catch means to hold inside, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: war is fighting

indicators.note: gutted removes the insides, leaving only the outer letters

explanation.surface: A heron fights to catch a dace and guts it.
explanation.walkthrough: A dace is a small freshwater fish.
explanation.definitionFit: Herons are long-legged birds that stand in shallow water, examples of a wading bird.

clue.text: Kind of joint violated when out of order

indicators.note: out of order means the letters are not in sequence and must be rearranged

explanation.surface: A joint is violated when it is out of order.
explanation.definitionFit: A dovetail is a woodworking joint of interlocking wedge-shaped tenons.

clue.text: Blend of recipes with meat as chef d'oeuvre

indicators.note: a blend mixes things together, so the letters are combined and rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: A chef blends recipes with meat to create a signature dish.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' joins the fodder and 'as' links to the definition; 'chef' is French for chief, so chef d'oeuvre is a masterwork, not a cook's dish.
explanation.definitionFit: Chef d'oeuvre is the French term for an artist's finest work.

clue.text: The Sun's for me!

parts.note: the sun goes down each evening, and the one who compiles this puzzle speaks of themself

explanation.walkthrough: Read as the sun saying who it is, it is the one that sets; read as the compiler, it is the person who made this crossword.
explanation.definitionFit: A crossword compiler is called by that title, and it is also a thing that sinks below the horizon.

clue.text: Potatoes and cabbages etc stuffing endive, generally

indicators.note: stuffing means filling the inside, so the letters are within the words

explanation.surface: Potatoes and cabbages stuffed with endive, as a rule.
explanation.definitionFit: Veg is the informal short form of vegetables.

clue.text: Stone figure newspaper erected

indicators.note: in a down clue, erected means raised up, so the letters read bottom to top

parts.note: ten is a figure or number
a rag is slang for a low-quality newspaper

explanation.surface: A newspaper puts up a statue of stone.
explanation.definitionFit: A garnet is a deep red semi-precious gemstone.

clue.text: Blade caused maiden to bleed

parts.note: caused ... to bleed is to cut, with the maiden standing between the phrase
a lass is a maiden or girl

explanation.surface: A blade made a young woman bleed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'caused maiden to bleed' reads as CUT LASS: the girl is wounded.
explanation.definitionFit: A cutlass is a short curved sword with a broad blade, used by sailors.

clue.text: Voice in Scotland, uplifting

indicators.note: in a down clue, uplifting reads the letters bottom to top
in signals letters lying inside the word

explanation.surface: A singing voice in Scotland, raising the spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: An alto is a low female or high male singing voice.

clue.text: Constable, say, one punching deepbreather?

indicators.note: punching means going into, so one piece is inside the other

parts.note: someone who pants breathes hard and deep
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A police constable punches a heavy breather.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Constable' looks like a policeman; it is John Constable, the English landscape painter.
explanation.definitionFit: John Constable was a famous English landscape artist, an example of the answer.

clue.text: Poet John, Paul or Adrian, perhaps?

definitions.meaning: names taken by heads of the Roman Catholic Church

explanation.walkthrough: 'John, Paul' suggests the Beatles, but these are papal names: John Paul, Adrian IV.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both the English poet Alexander and the head of the Catholic Church.

clue.text: Competition finely balanced, heading for tie

parts.note: a contest that is even is finely balanced

indicators.note: heading for picks the first letter of the next word

explanation.surface: A competition is finely balanced, heading for a tie.
explanation.definitionFit: An event is a contest at a sports meeting.

clue.text: Fiery old bird endlessly touring central Asia

parts.note: ex means former, old

indicators.note: touring means going round, so one piece wraps the other
endlessly drops the last letter of the word

parts.note: the plover is a wading bird

indicators.note: central picks the middle letters of the word

explanation.surface: An old bird with a fiery temper travels across central Asia.
explanation.walkthrough: 'bird' cut short by 'endlessly' gives PLOVE, which 'touring' wraps round the middle pair of 'Asia'.
explanation.definitionFit: Explosive describes a fiery, volatile temper liable to burst out.
